definitions.explanation: Suffix attached to quantity expressions to indicate equal distribution or gradual progression. Shows that something is done in equal portions or increments.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧ずつ⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧ずつ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I gradually came to understand Japanese little by little.

examples.japanese: ⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧ずつ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦グループ→グループ：03840_guruupu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please form groups of three people each.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧{一|いっ}⟦{枚|まい}→〜枚：00650_mai⟧ずつ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧、⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take one sheet of paper each and write your name.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧ずつ⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えれば→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧、⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧⟦{年|ねん}→〜年：09876_nen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{読|よ}める→読む：00426_yomu⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you learn kanji little by little every day, you'll be able to read many kanji in a year.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- Number + counter + ずつ: ⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧ずつ (one each), ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧ずつ (two each)
- ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧ずつ (little by little, gradually)
- ⟦{一歩|いっぽ}→一歩：08890_ippo⟧ずつ (step by step)
- ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧ずつ (day by day)

USAGE:
1. Equal distribution: {一|いっ}⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧ずつ⟦{配|くば}る→配る：03921_kubaru⟧ (distribute one each)
2. Gradual progression: ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧ずつ⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (get better little by little)

The suffix attaches directly to the quantity word without particles.
